title: Turkey's Geography
text:
Turkey is a country. It is on two continents: Europe and Asia. Turkey has many mountains and rivers. Ankara is the capital city.

The Black Sea is in the north. The Mediterranean Sea is in the south. There are many beaches on the coast. People like to visit them in summer.

questions.text: What are the two continents where Turkey is?
Which sea is in the north?
Why might people visit the beaches in summer?
options: Because the weather is warm and nice
Because the beaches are very cold
Because there are no people there
Because the beaches are in the mountains

questions.text: What can we say about Turkey's geography?
options: It has many different landforms and water

vocabulary.definition: very large areas of land, such as Europe or Asia
very high areas of land with steep sides
the land along the edge of the sea
the city where the government of a country is

paragraph_translations: Türkiye bir ülkedir. İki kıtada yer alır: Avrupa ve Asya. Türkiye'de birçok dağ ve nehir vardır. Ankara başkent şehirdir.
Karadeniz kuzeyde yer alır. Akdeniz güneyde yer alır. Kıyıda birçok plaj vardır. İnsanlar yazın onları ziyaret etmeyi sever.
